notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: There was a known bug where the progress could not be saved completely and players would loose hixcoins, viruses or any other software while there mission progress was intact. I have fixed this issue and there shouldn't be a problem with the saving mechanism anymore. If you find any more bugs, don't forget to make a post about it! Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Bug Fixes for Hacker.exe
notes.notes: Hello dear players! I have been working on fixing a nasty bug that prohinited many players from accessing the message tab on the phone because the game would crash. This has been fixed now and should work accordingly. Please don't hesitate if you find any other bug. Thank you for playing and keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: Hacker.exe is available for MAC OS + Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Hey everyone! I hope everyone is enjoying the game so far! I just wanted all those Mac gamers that [b]Hacker.exe[/b] is now [b]availble[/b] for Mac! The game now has a couple of bug fixes such as an increase in the VPN time and also a now a save feature that will not restart the game from the beggining if you get caught and loose. Note that there is still a possibility of you having to start over when you get caught in certain cutscenes, so keep your eyes opened! Enjoy the game everyone! I will be checking around the forums for more bugs/recommendations and improve the game as so!
